statement: For any nondegenerate triangle, construct a center and positive radius whose circle contains all three vertices.
proof_spine: Reuse the Cramer circumcenter and its equidistance proof; exclude center=vertex using positive distance to another vertex; choose sqrt(distance_sq) as positive radius.
source_correspondence: Analytic perpendicular-bisector solution; same construction conclusion as IV.5, independent of IV.2.
